prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Irene, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Irene thinks the council should be stricter about bins on the sidewalk.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I heard a rumor that the neighborhood council might start fining people for leaving bins out after 8am, but I’m not sure how true it is. It might be worth double-checking just in case."
text: The council is officially cracking down and will be issuing heavy fines for any bins left out after 8am. It’s finally time they started enforcing some serious rules around here!
